fee_schedule.note: The project's FeeSchedule HAS a maker tier, but DESIGN.md §10.2 sets spot_maker_bps == spot_taker_bps (10 bps) because it assumes no maker rebates. So break_even_edge_bps_maker (project model) legitimately equals break_even_edge_bps_taker on spot. The genuine maker what-if uses ANALYST_SPOT_MAKER_BPS=2.0 (Binance 0.02% spot maker), supplied by the analyst and reported separately as break_even_edge_bps_maker_analyst_supplied.
